skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and handling zero fractional results.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers, fractions, and mixed numbers in compatible whole-plus-fraction form, subtract whole-number parts, and combine the final whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrow for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the minuend fractional part is too small to subtract the subtrahend fractional part.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or mixed-number fractional part to lowest terms.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Separate and combine whole-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole and mixed numbers as whole-plus-fraction parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more whole units as denominator-sized fractional units when the minuend fraction part is too small.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize result
skills.definition: Put the result in standard form by reducing fractional parts to lowest terms or converting a zero fractional part to an integer.

skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction and normalization
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts that share a denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and reducing or normalizing the fractional result when necessary.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, preferably the LCD, and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed or whole subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: For operands with whole-number parts when the fractional subtraction is nonnegative, align whole and fraction parts using zero parts as needed, subtract whole parts, and recombine.

skills.name: Mixed or whole subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: For operands with whole-number parts when the fractional subtraction is negative, borrow one or more whole units into the fractional part, adjust the whole part, and recombine.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fraction denominators and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators, including cases where the numerator difference is zero.

skills.name: Handle whole and mixed-number parts
skills.definition: For operands containing whole-number parts, separate or align whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result as a mixed number or integer.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes into denominator-equivalent fractional units when the minuend's fractional part is insufficient for subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator.

skills.name: Convert unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator or LCD for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Operate with mixed or whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, use implicit zero parts when needed, subtract whole parts, and recombine the final whole and fractional components.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup by reducing the whole-number part and adding one or more denominator-over-denominator units to the fractional minuend when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or normalize a zero fractional part into an appropriate integer or zero result.
